'''NA-71''' was a [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] owned by the [[Star Cabal]]. During the [[Galactic War]] it was welcoming guests to an apocalypse party during the [[Battle of Corellia]] at the [[Coronet City Spaceport/Legends|Coronet Spaceport]] on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].
